description: b = a then a[i] = x is visible through b: alloc'd arrays are mutable buffers, unlike Elixir's immutable values. Options: forbid aliasing writable arrays, copy-on-write, or a uniqueness check (Perceus-style refcount == 1). Document the choice in README.

title: Decide array value semantics (aliasing on write)
